title: Solution Engineer - Integrations Focus
description: Brickanta is only as strong as the data it can reach. Our customers run their projects across Autodesk, Dalux, Bidcon, SharePoint, Dropbox, ERPs, and a long tail of customised APIs they built themselves. Your job is to make Brickanta the agentic layer on top of all of it, and to make sure every enterprise customer actually gets there. Think of it as a forward deployed engineer sitting inside Customer Success. You'll write code, read API docs, map data models and debug auth flows. You'll also run workshops, present to IT security, and sit with a project manager to understand how a change order really moves. Half engineer, half deployment lead, fully accountable for the outcome. We optimize for builders who ship, and this role ships with a customer in the room. What You'll Build Connectors to the systems our customers live in: Autodesk Construction Cloud and BIM 360, Dalux, Bidcon, SharePoint, Dropbox and more The harder integrations - customer-specific APIs, homegrown project databases, document archives and more The technical architecture of enterprise rollouts: discovery, solution design, IT security reviews, SSO, permissions, data residency Playbooks, documentation and reference setups that turn one-off integrations into repeatable product, so the next ten customers onboard without you Adoption in real workflows, such as; tender review, risk analysis, change orders, procurement Prototypes directly in Brickanta when that's the fastest way to prove a case to product and engineering Who This Is For Solutions engineers, implementation engineers, and technical people from inside the built environment who can build. You need to have onboarded real customers onto a real product, and you need to build and debug integrations yourself in Python or TypeScript. Bonus if you know how a Swedish entreprenad runs. About Brickanta Brickanta (Brickanta.com) is the AI-native agentic platform for construction bid analysis, cost estimation and procurement. Brickanta's industry know-how AI raises margins and saves time by leveraging historical estimates, tender documents, and project data - so builders can focus on building. The founding team has been building with AI since 2018 and brings deep experience applying AI in construction and industrial sectors. Brickanta has raised over $8M in external funding from leading investors, including Northzone, Anton Osika and Mario Götze. Are you keen on doing your life's work - bringing one of the world's largest and most impactful industries, the $15 trillion construction industry, into the AI era? Apply directly at https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/brickanta/jobs/9PcN4kH-solution-engineer-integrations-focus.
